description: Landscaping works to the Plaza in centre of site and the relocation of the existing satellite dishes to the roof of Sky 4

Condition : 3 - The details of lighting as shown on the approved plans and specifications shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use and retained thereafter, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.

Condition : 4 - The details of hard and soft landscaping including the tree protection and tree planting proposals as shown on the approved plans and specifications shall be laid out and planted before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use. Any trees or plants that, within 5 years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall take place in accordance with the submitted Biodiversity Enhancement Strategy. Within three months of completion the development a Habitat Management Plan shall be submitted and to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Habitat Management Plan should include:
(i)	details of how the enhancement measures will be monitored, managed and maintained, including the long- term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules
(ii)	additional detail on location and type of bird/bat boxes, maintenance and a commitment that any data collected is to be shared with the Council;
(iii)	a commitment to undertake habitat monitoring annually by a qualified ecologist.

Condition : 6 - a)	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed drainage design drawings provided within the Drainage Modelling Report, dated 16 December 2021 (BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3100, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3101, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3150, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3151, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3152, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3160, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3161, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3170, BSB-ARP-PX-XX-DR-CD-3171)
b)	The development shall be maintained in accordance with the Maintenance  Plan submitted as part of the Drainage Modelling Report, dated 16 December 2021

Condition : 7 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be first used until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 8 - During the course of the development:
(a) Additional soil testing is required to confirm the ground conditions and levels of contamination of the areas where have not been subject to previous investigation, subsequent to the Ground Contamination Appraisal Report previously submitted. The site shall be investigated by a competent person in order to inform the level of site safety and control procedures during the groundworks, suitability and compliance for on-site material reuse, and classification for off-site waste disposal.
(b)  The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if unexpected contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
(c) Soils or other landscaping materials imported to the site should be demonstrated to be safe for use in accordance with a scheme of verification and testing to be agreed with the local authority.
Before the development is first brought into use:
(d)  The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses (a), (b) and (c) above, including any amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
